data.title: About Cathy
bio: Cathy brings the Green Light Realty approach — technology, local knowledge, and a relationships-first mindset — to clients throughout Central Jersey.
Whether you're buying your first home or selling to move up, Cathy walks you through pricing, neighborhoods, and next steps so nothing catches you off guard.
Reach out to Cathy for local market expertise and guidance from first conversation to closing day.
